newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Dec 16.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Members of the conservative majority, former prime minister Edouard Balladur and former president Valery Giscard d'Estaing critical of president Jacques Chirac for showing "pessimism" about the French economic and social situation.
-- A planned McDonnell Douglas -Boeing merger creates the new aircraft industry world leader.
-- Executive reshuffle after merger of Axa and UAP expected to be announced at the end of this week.
